items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I danced, I did my act and I did a number with Judy Garland called -- what's the name of that song?

ctx.x: What did you do in that show?
I danced, I did my act and I did a number with Judy Garland called -- what's the name of that song? "Me and My Shadow," is it? Yeah, "Me and My Shadow" I think we did.
